research.facts:
Tennessee Opens Fall Ball Tonight
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Game: Tennessee vs. Walters State, TODAY Sept. 25 at 6 PM CT
- Venue: Sherri Parker Lee Stadium, Knoxville, TN
- Admission: FREE. Gates open one hour before first pitch. No concessions available.
- Sage Mardjetko 2026: 16-3 record, 171 K, 1.26 ERA — NFCA 1st Team All-American
- Erin Nuwer 2026: 15-1 record, 90 K, 1.01 ERA
- Combined Mardjetko/Nuwer in 2026: 31 wins, 8 shutouts
- Sophia Knight led all UT players with .394 BA in 2026
- Emma Clarke (14 HR), Alannah Leach (13 HR), Gabby Leach (10 HR) all returning
- Tennessee returns 9 starters from 2026 WCWS squad
- Upcoming fall home games: Lipscomb Sept. 27, Carson-Newman Oct. 2, Northeast Alabama Oct. 9, Northwest Florida State Oct. 10, Roane State Oct. 11, Lee University Oct. 23
- Road game: Oct. 18 at Murfreesboro vs. Middle Tennessee
**Sources:** utsports.com fall schedule release; WIVK "Lady Vols Swing into Fall Ball Action" (Sept. 23)

research.facts:
Texas Longhorns — 4 Days to Opener
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Fall opener: Sept. 29 at McCombs Field vs. Murray State College, 6 PM CT, FREE
- Texas won back-to-back WCWS titles (2025, 2026); defeated Texas Tech in 2026 championship series
- Teagan Kavan: first athlete in WCWS history to win back-to-back MOP awards (2025 + 2026); Softball America No. 1 on its Top 100 list for 2026
- Isa Torres: D1Softball National Player of the Year 2026 at FSU; transferred to Texas as senior
- Torres is a Georgetown, TX native — homecoming story
- Additional transfers: Samantha Swan (Sr. C, Arizona State) and Samantha Lincoln (Jr. LHP, Texas Tech)
- Three-peat history: only UCLA 1988-90 and Oklahoma 2021-23 have three-peated in college softball
- Texas faces Tennessee, Alabama, and Arkansas on back-to-back-to-back 2027 SEC weekends
**Sources:** texaslonghorns.com fall schedule; NCAA.com 2026 championship; wbsc.org Kavan WCWS MOP history; 247Sports Texas three-peat preview

research.facts:
Oklahoma Sooners — 5 Days to Love's Field
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Fall opener: Sept. 30 (intrasquad Battle Series) at Love's Field, 6:30 PM — tickets $10.88/game, All Fall Pass $70.69
- First game vs. outside opponent: Oct. 3 vs. Tarleton State, 1 PM at Love's Field
- Full fall slate runs Sept. 30 through Nov. 4 (Tarleton State, USAO, Seminole State, East Texas A&M)
- Kendall Wells 2026 final season line: .358 avg, 39 HR, 88 RBI — broke NCAA freshman HR record during season (31st HR vs. Texas) and finished with 39 total, breaking all-time NCAA single-season HR record (prev. 37 by Laura Espinoza 1995)
- Wells awards: NFCA Freshman of the Year, SEC Freshman of the Year, Diamond Sports/NFCA Catcher of the Year, Johnny Bench Award (first freshman ever to win)
- Sydney Berzon (LSU transfer, now OU): career 2.02 ERA, 52 wins, 416 K in 486.1 IP, two-time All-American
- Macie Harter (MTSU transfer): .346 BA
- OU seeking 9th national title in 2027 after falling to Texas in 2026
**Sources:** soonersports.com fall schedule; NCAA.com Wells record; OU Daily/SI Wells stats; WBRZ Berzon transfer confirmation

Asian Games Softball Opens Tomorrow in Japan
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**

- Preliminary rounds: Sept. 26–Oct. 2; Finals/Gold Medal: Oct. 3

- Japan is host nation and overwhelming favorite as world No. 1
- Event has LA28 Olympic qualification pathway implications
